name: Target Lens
description: Customizable target HUD: buffs/debuffs, threat/aggro, boss skill timers and a live cast bar.
author: Stellar

media.caption: Target overlays in a boss fight — HP + break gauge, the effect list (★ = your own), threat/aggro %, and the cast bar.
Grouped settings — display style, effect-source filters, threat, cast bar and boss timers.

added: Lock the HUD onto your target — a new hotkey pins the overlays to your current target so they keep showing that enemy even while you fight others. Press again to release; it also clears on its own when the target dies. Assign a key for it in the launcher's hotkey settings.
Resize each overlay on its own — the target effects list, threat/aggro list, cast bar and boss skill timers each get their own size slider.
Choose how threat/aggro is shown — everyone's threat share, or just whoever currently holds the boss's attention.
Stacking effects now show their stack count (for example 3×) next to the name.
changed: Each overlay's title can now be hidden, and titles keep a fixed size when you scale an overlay up.
